cake.definitionKo: 밀가루에 달걀, 버터, 우유, 설탕 등을 넣어 반죽하여 오븐에 구운 뒤 생크림이나 과일 등으로 장식한 빵.
cake.englishDescription: Bread made by mixing flour, eggs, butter, milk, sugar, etc., making the mixture as a dough, baking the dough in an oven, then decorating the baked bread with cream, fruits, etc.

cello.definitionKo: 바이올린보다 낮은 소리를 내고 더 크기가 크며, 의자에 앉아 무릎 사이에 끼고 네 개의 줄을 활로 문질러 연주하는 악기.
cello.englishDescription: A four-stringed musical instrument that is pitched lower and sounds louder than the violin, played by holding it between one's knees on a chair and rubbing the strings with a bow.

check-out.definitionKo: 호텔 등의 숙박 시설에서 떠날 때 치러야 할 요금을 계산해서 냄.
check-out.englishDescription: An act of paying for the stay at a place such as a hotel, etc.

gate.definitionKo: 비행기를 타기 위해 승강장으로 나가는 문.
gate.englishDescription: A door through which a passenger passes to board the plane.
A word attached to another noun to mean an incident involving political corruption or scandals.

good-looking.definitionKo: 주로 남자가, 체격이 좋거나 얼굴이 깔끔하게 잘생기다.
good-looking.englishDescription: Usually used for men, being well-built and having a neat and attractive appearance.

homesickness.definitionKo: 고향이나 지난 시절을 몹시 그리워하는 마음.
homesickness.englishDescription: The feeling of longing for home or old days.

hula-hoop.definitionKo: 둥근 테를 허리나 목으로 빙빙 돌리는 놀이. 또는 그 테.
hula-hoop.englishDescription: A game played by spinning a round hoop using the waist or neck; or the hoop.

pancake.definitionKo: 밀가루에 달걀, 우유, 설탕을 넣고 반죽하여 팬에서 구운 둥글납작한 모양의 케이크.
pancake.englishDescription: A flat, round cake, made by making a batter of flour, eggs, milk, and sugar, and cooking it in a pan.

playing.definitionKo: 피아노의 건반이나 컴퓨터의 자판을 누르거나 두드림.
playing.englishDescription: An act of pressing or stroking the keys of a piano or a computer.

unmask.definitionKo: 거짓으로 꾸민 모습을 버리고 본래의 모습을 드러내다.
unmask.englishDescription: To stop disguising oneself and reveal one's true self.
